title: Mobility Equipment Quality Review Standard — Lemon Review on Drive-Unit Claims
content:
# Lemon Review Allowance — Drive-Unit Claims on Mobility Equipment

A lemon-review allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty drive motor or gearbox replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the number of repair estimate requests on the chair: **2 units for 4 or more, 1 unit for exactly 3, and nothing for fewer.**

## Ladder

| Repair estimate requests recorded on the chair | Lemon-review allowance |
|---|---|
| fewer than 3 | none |
| exactly 3 | 1 unit |
| 4 or more | 2 units |

Every repair estimate request on the chair's wheelchair record counts, whatever its status.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a fifth request raise the allowance further?** No; 4 or more requests give 2 units.

**Hypothetical case.** A chair with 3 repair estimate requests on file, the latest for the present drive-unit fault: 1 unit.
